title: Failure
description: One failure, provider-independent: the catalogue class, which side it came from, and whether the request was refused before anything was delivered. Read from the Desk's AIFailure (web/src/assistant/failures.ts, readFailure) and aifailure.Failure (internal/aifailure/failure.go). Open: readFailure accepts a member it does not name and drops it, and the Go reader ignores it. The message and recovery a person sees are the catalogue's (contract/desk/catalog.json), never provider prose; detail is host-authored only.

status.description: The HTTP status the failure was classified from, where there was one.

requestId.description: The provider's request-id or x-request-id header, where it matched this pattern.

retryAt.description: When a retry-after header allows another attempt: an absolute time, at most 24 hours ahead. The reader accepts any string of at most 64 characters that Date.parse reads; the Desk writes ISO 8601.

detail.description: A host-authored sentence that replaces the catalogue message (authoredFailure). Never provider prose, bodies, URLs, headers or stacks.

code.description: The catalogue's classes, the keys of failures in contract/desk/catalog.json, spelled as the Desk spells them.

source.description: Which side the failure came from (FailureSource).

outcome.description: not-started: positively refused at admission, nothing ran (an agent run is retried after it only with code busy: canRetryAdmission). refused: a 4xx other than 408, the request was refused (a model request is sent again after it only for the refusals failures.ts names: the rate-limited class and the overload code overloaded_error, canRetryRefusal, at most twice). unknown: anything else, including every 5xx and timeout; never retried by the engine, replay safety is never inferred. One exception, a delegated child's (agent#17, delegated-task.json retried): a 5xx other than 504 that carries the rate-limited class or the overload code overloaded_error, before the child's first answer byte, is sent once more.

recovery.description: The recovery a catalogue entry names for the person.

catalogueEntry.description: One entry of the catalogue's failures map.

toolFailureContent.description: The structuredContent of a tool result that failed (toolFailureResult): the failure itself, so a failed tool is recoverable working data rather than a failed turn.
